stated_posture: Both parties declared a war of annihilation. Germany's stated aim was conquest and Lebensraum; the USSR's was the destruction of the invader. No party claimed a limited or managed conflict.

sources: German-Soviet Commercial Agreement (1940), terminated at invasion 22 June 1941; standard Barbarossa economic historiography
trade.rationale: Trade severed at the moment of invasion and stayed severed. The 1940 commercial agreement, which had been running deliveries up to the eve of Barbarossa, ended absolutely. Enforcement total on both sides.

transit.rationale: No transit continuity of any kind. The contested space WAS the front line; there was no corridor, pipeline or overflight arrangement to preserve.

sources: Absence of any notification channel is itself well documented across the Eastern Front literature
deconfliction.rationale: No hotline, no notification, no third-party channel used for warning. Strikes unannounced by design.

sources: Sieges of Leningrad and Stalingrad; strategic bombing of industrial centres; operations against leadership and command
target_selection.rationale: Decisive targets struck without reservation: capitals besieged, industry targeted, command and leadership attacked. Nothing held back as available-but-unstruck.

sources: n/a - no sanctions regime existed between the belligerents
sanctions.rationale: CATEGORY NOT APPLICABLE. Sanctions are an instrument for parties not in open total war; there was no regime, carve-out or licensing to measure. Recorded as SPECULATIVE so it moves nothing rather than inventing a score.

sources: Wartime shipping, insurance and aviation records for the Eastern theatre
civil_continuity.rationale: Civil shipping, banking and aviation across the line suspended entirely. War-risk cover for the contested zone did not meaningfully exist.

sources: n/a - historical case, no pre-registered threshold
market_prepositioning.rationale: No KKR projection declared an instrument, window and threshold before the event. By rule this indicator contributes nothing. Left unregistered deliberately.
